summary: Provides static helper methods for parsing numeric strings into Decimal or Integer types, with custom null values if parsing fails.
purpose: To safely parse string representations of numbers into typed numeric values, providing fallback (null) values when parsing is unsuccessful.

workflows.name: ParseDecimal workflow
steps: Receive input string (NumberString) and decimal nullValue.
Attempt to parse NumberString into a Decimal.
If parsing succeeds, return parsed Decimal.

workflows.name: ParseInt workflow
steps: Receive input string (NumberString) and integer nullValue.
Attempt to parse NumberString into an Integer.
If parsing succeeds, return parsed Integer.

business_rules: All number string parsing should use the provided methods to ensure consistent handling of parse failures with supplied null values.
validations: Input NumberString is validated using Decimal.TryParse or Int32.TryParse.
conditions: If parsing of NumberString succeeds, return parsed value.
If parsing fails, return the provided nullValue parameter.
system_behavior: Does not throw an exception if parsing fails; returns a caller-supplied default value instead.
Supports handling both decimals and integers.
exceptions: Parsing failure is handled gracefully by returning nullValue instead of throwing.
